column1: # Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment (Switch 2, update v196608)
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL, SDK 20.5.15 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# Packed from a NUP container (scripts/pack_nup.py). RomFS: KTGL's RDB under b6e28c40 (root.rdb, system.rdb, .fdata, data/*.file), and .bin archives under ebc8c781
# v196608 is the update's title version; the NUP carries no control data to name a display version
# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure, not measured here). The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): no virtual address memory.
# 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 9 GB heap region
